steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sora, are you ready yet?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Stop rushing me!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Urgh... This dress is so tight!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You haven't been chubbing up on pizza behind my back, have you?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What are you even talking about? I only had one extra slice last night!

spans.text: What are you even talking about? I only had

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sora, suck it in!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hissss—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Alrighty! Perfect!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You're good.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Done? Come on out already and let me see!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Coming, coming.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Wooooah, you look amazing!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You'n say that again. One purdy lady!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Heehee.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: *sigh*... If only Texas was here to see you too.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I knew you had it in ya though, Sora. Ya made it onstage here in Siracusa mighty quick.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But of course~

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: This time, 'La Morte di Texas' will be presented in multiple acts. We've already finished rehearsing the first one, and the opening night is the day after tomorrow!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If everything goes well, maybe she'll be the one looking for me, rather than the other way around~

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That could happen. Lemme think... Yeah, if it comes to that, I'm definitely gonna buy a pizza to slap her face around a bit.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Speakin' of Texas, I've been talkin' up the Bellone family. I hear tell things've been awful rough for 'em lately. Hope that ain't gettin' in her way.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: She's gonna be perfectly fine.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Most we'n do right now is keep the faith in her.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We oughta rest up before Sora's debut too.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I originally wanted to take a look around the city, but it feels like I've turned into Sora's bodyguard.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Bite me.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But hey, I've eaten my weight in the free food at the theater. Hehe, their pizza's not half bad.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Things are probably only gonna get busier from here on out, so let's go for a walk.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Cheery Actress
steps.text: Hey, did you hear...?

steps.name: Meddlesome Actress
steps.text: You're talking... Tex... right?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Cheery Actress
steps.text: Right, Texas... sentenced...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Ehh?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Excuse me, did you just say something about Texas?

steps.name: Cheery Actress
steps.text: Yup, sure did. You interested?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What happened to Texas?

steps.name: Cheery Actress
steps.text: My boyfriend's with Famiglia Bellone, and I heard it from him.

steps.name: Cheery Actress
steps.text: You know how il Ministro dei Lavori Pubblici was killed a few days ago?

steps.name: Cheery Actress
steps.text: Apparently, they found the culprit.

steps.name: Cheery Actress
steps.text: The one who did it was the last of the Texas bloodline. I think her name was Cellinia or something?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No way!

steps.name: Cheery Actress
steps.text: They even decided on the court date. It's the day after tomorrow.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Signor Leontuzzo, we agreed on this meeting, but you've already pushed it back several times.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: My sincerest apologies, Signor Wallach, but I've had too much to deal with lately.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I hear you've already withdrawn a lot of your men from several areas previously under contention with other famiglie. I'm worried about you.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I'm glad to see that you're alive and well.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: It's nothing major, just cutting our losses.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Haha, I'm quite fond of that prudent side of yours.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Don't worry, Famiglia Rossati has no interest in kicking a man when he's down.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: But there is one problem that I must reluctantly bring up.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: It has to be about Texas.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: 'Cellinia Texas.' Is she back, and even one of your bodyguards?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Is it really her?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: What if I say yes?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: We never knew she was alive this whole time.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Back then, it was my father who saved her.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I see, I see. This was the old don's handiwork.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The construction of the new city was, from the very beginning, because of the fate Salvadore shared with Siracusa. My father only hoped she could return to Siracusa to see the city.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Such is Famiglia Bellone.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Despite knowing full well the significance of the Texas name to Famiglia Rossati, you still invited her to come back so graciously.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Impressive. Truly impressive.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I, Wallach, can only offer my admiration.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Again with your jokes.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Jokes? How is any of this a joke?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The news that Signorina Cellinia is still alive means a great deal to us Rossatis.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: No matter how the Bellones see it, we are in your debt.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Our two famiglie will see this new city built, hand-in-hand. What debt is there to speak of?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Hahaha! Very good, I love it!

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: By the looks of things, fratello, you've been waiting for me all this time.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: So tell me, what is it you want?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Simple—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: For the Rossatis to stay out of this.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Oh? You want us to stand aside and watch the last Texas go down? That's not going to fly with the boss.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: After the trial is over, she'll be held in custody and you'll still be able to see her.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Just see her?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: She's our guest, but she could also be yours.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Alright, it's a deal!

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: So this is when you decide to reveal Cellinia? That's certainly unexpected...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Was it Lavinia's idea? No... There's no way for her to know that Cellinia wasn't the murderer.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Knowing her, this isn't a decision she'd make.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Could Leon have convinced her?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Never mind. In any case, I didn't expect this card to get played.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Demetri, what're we doin' now?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Time to rub out Cellinia?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Do you have any idea how many heavies she put down during the chaos that broke out seven years ago?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: An ambush, explosives, or a good, old-fashioned poisoning. We might have a way...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: But don't forget to take into account whoever invited her back.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Whoever they might be, it undeniably was a clever move.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Now that things have come to this, we're forced to resort to more... brutal methods to put this trial on ice.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: At the end of the day, our goal is to plunge the city into chaos.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: From the very beginning, we've been here to provoke Signora Sicilia.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Now, all we're doing is taking another step forward.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Gotcha.
If you ask me, I think there's another option.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Whatever you're doing sounds like fun. Mind if I join in?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Director, did you hear the news about Texas?!

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I did, just now.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Do you have any clue what's going on behind the scenes?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I got the news from Judge Lavinia's own announcement.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Lavinia, the judge who helped me...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She... doesn't seem like the type to lie, but...

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Are you going to postpone your debut?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Could you... please help me come up with something?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I at least... want to see her first.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: And regardless of whether or not your debut can be pushed back...

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I want to know what happens when you do see her.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Signorina Sora, I remember you said you came to Siracusa with two friends to look for her.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You always believed in the woman you knew, that she was truly who you thought she was.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: But now, you know her hidden past.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You've been forced to learn that the woman you've been chasing might be an entirely different person.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Say you go see her. What then?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: What are you going to say to her, and what is she going to say to you?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If that's the way things are, then maybe it's all my own fault. Maybe I never knew her well enough.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Even if she was clearly keeping something from you?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That depends on her reason for doing it.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Anyway, Mr. Bernardo, showbiz is a big melting pot, and I've met all kinds.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It's way too hard to be the person you claim to be. At least, I don't think I can pull it off.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I always think to myself, one day I'm going to turn into someone I'm not.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So, I never expect it from other people.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Everybody has their secrets. I do, she does, and I'm sure you do too.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If she wants to keep her mask on until the very end, and that's the side she wants me to see, isn't that also genuine, in its own way?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Absolutely.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Also, maybe I didn't express myself clearly enough.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm not looking for Texas so I can give her a piece of my mind. Not at all.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: The four of us lived together in Lungmen for almost six years.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Six years, precious to me beyond words.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And I sincerely believe... they're just as precious to her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Still, she still left without saying goodbye.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Should I be upset over that?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm not. I'm worried sick about her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Exusiai and Croissant would say the same thing.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's why we came to Siracusa.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If she's caught up in some trouble, then we're going to bail her out.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If the weight of her past is enough to make her crumble, we'll be there to share that burden with her.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Through many plays, the fate of Famiglia Texas is known far and wide, even if the rumors of Cellinia's death were exaggerated.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Her past is likely much deeper than you can imagine.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But we haven't heard it from her, directly.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She has to tell us what she thinks herself.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Only then, if she still decides to part ways with us, after everything we've been through... Only then can I say goodbye without a weight on my heart.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Only if I try my best, can go move on without any regrets.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Well... I'd probably still have some regrets, but they wouldn't be that bad.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You speak with a great deal of wisdom, Signorina Sora.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm just trying to come up with excuses for my bravado, that's all.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But I do feel much better after having talking to you about this.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You are right, though. If I went to see her right now, I don't think there's anything I'd be able to do for her.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Actually, I was ready to agree to your request.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: After the trial, you will see her. I can promise you that.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Really?!

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: But for the time being, you'll have to keep waiting.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thank you so much! I have got to get ready first.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Unfortunately, I won't be there to see your debut in person.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh? You're not going to watch?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: That's right. I'm afraid I have something important to do that day.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: But, don't worry. I've already prepared the best possible stage for you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'd better get going, then.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: See you.
Bernardo walks over to the shelf and pulls out a book.
A legal codex wrapped in thorns.
He remains silent for a long time until finally, he places a call.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Demetri... tell her. Just say, I agreed.
With a boom, thunder surges outside the window.
It seems to augur the heavy rain about to come.
